Hi Laura — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from my side and a single ask at the bottom.

TL;DR: You want to reduce inference cost for your customer-facing summarization pipeline while keeping median latency under 350ms. You have a pilot window in June and procurement needs a rough cost estimate by 6/10.

What we heard:
- Primary goal: lower per-inference token cost by ~40% vs current hosted provider without increasing 95th pct latency beyond 600ms.
- Workload: short summaries, 150-400 tokens total, batched by session affinity.
- Data constraints: PII filtering on ingest; logs retention 30 days.
- Success metric: cost per 1M tokens and error rate on critical prompts.

Suggested next step:
1) Pilot: 2-week pilot in your staging environment running ~5k requests/day. Redwood provides a dedicated 1x GPU pool and a prebuilt prompt set.
2) Deliverables: sample throughput/latency report, cost projection, and a short ops playbook.

One small ask for you — 3 quick signals so we know whether to prioritize this for a dedicated pilot: 
- A: Priority: must-run pilot in June (yes/no)
- B: Procurement readiness: do you need a formal SOW to start internal procurement (yes/no)
- C: Blockers: any legal/security checklist items we should pre-fill? (short list)

If you reply with A/B/C I can turn this into a 1-page pilot plan and slot time for engineering to set up a sandbox. Slides from the call attached.

Attachments: 20270520-discovery-slides.pdf

Thanks —
